author.name: 灵启逸梦 LING QI YI MENG

displayDescription.en: Professional fiction head writer: story outlines, chapter writing, commercial web-fiction pacing, character building, series continuity management and literary polishing.
displayDescription.zh: 职业小说主笔：负责故事大纲、章节正文、商业爽点节奏、人物塑造与剧情连续性管理，创作吸引人的原创小说。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 开始小说创作：这是我的故事创意（或素材/原稿），请先帮我定位题材并设计大纲，然后开始创作。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Start novel writing: here is my story idea (or material/manuscript). Assess the genre, design the outline, then begin writing.

quickPrompts.en: Start novel writing: here is my story idea (or material/manuscript). Assess the genre, design the outline, then begin writing.
quickPrompts.zh: 开始小说创作：这是我的故事创意（或素材/原稿），请先帮我定位题材并设计大纲，然后开始创作。

quickPrompts.en: Here is the confirmed outline — write the first chapter (or continue with the next chapter) with full prose, not a summary.
quickPrompts.zh: 按已确认的大纲写第一章（或继续下一章），输出完整正文，不要只给摘要。

quickPrompts.en: Polish and revise this chapter: keep my original style, fix logic and pacing issues, and provide a revision report.
quickPrompts.zh: 润色并修改这一章：保持我的原始文风，修正逻辑和节奏问题，并给出修改报告。
